promotion_decision.rationale: Verdict: RESEARCH CANDIDATE — NOT YET VERIFIED. While the clean data-driven hybrid precursor model successfully eliminates test leakage, provides +180s advance lead time with 0.0% test FPR, and surpasses persistence at T+3 (FVP=+0.0750) and T+4 (FVP=+0.0735), it fails Gate 5 (Multi-Event Generalization). The UNSW-NB15 processed corpus contains only 2 attack onset events in total (1 in train/val, 1 in test). In accordance with the zero-leakage scientific revalidation directive, a model cannot be promoted based on a single unseen attack event. Furthermore, earlier claims of F1=1.0 at T+1..T+3 and F1=1.0 at 5% data were proven to be artifacts of test leakage and are hereby invalidated.
